name: cv-builder
description: Builds CVs and resumes as PDFs, shaped to the target role by researching layouts and conventions that are proven to work with recruiters and ATS (applicant tracking) software. Use this skill whenever the user asks to create, build, write, draft, make, redo, tailor, or update a CV or resume, even if they only say "I need a CV for a job", paste their work history and ask for something they can send out, or mention applying for a specific position.
